correctness.rationale: A terminating cyclic base-p carry algorithm proves the uniform minimum digit sum of nonzero multiples of p^r-1. Complementary r-digit blocks show s_p((p^r-1)q)=r(p-1) for 1<=q<=p^r. Legendre then yields >=r for all selected d and equality at d=1. The next row has a selected binomial valuation zero. Finite independent Legendre checks cover 83,211 coefficients across 13 (p,r) cases, not used to prove the universal statement.

value.rationale: The distinct natural prime-power-minus-one family has a maximal-valuation plateau of p^r-1 consecutive multipliers followed by an immediate collapse to zero. This simultaneously controls all selected coefficients (quadratically many across the block), unlike the known single-binomial congruence, and resolves a sharp natural boundary in the least-extremal-row problem.
